MIND. [1] [Cur.]
Indecision, no longer wishes to think and act for herself. θ Nervous debility.
Very much depressed about herself, desire only to shut herself up away from people. θ Nervous debility.
Despairing. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
Hydrophobia.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Cur.]
Instant giddiness ; falling down in a swoon or fainting while standing or walking.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cur.]
Nervous headache ; lancinating, piercing pains all over head, forcing him to lie down and stretch himself ; head drawn backward, with stiffness of neck ; painful oscillation of brain, as if it were full of fluid ; neuralgic pains, starting in front and radiating to neck and face ; violent blows in region of cerebellum.
Sharp sticking pains over right eye, extending backwards over right side of head. θ Nervous debility.
Head beats like a hammer, with vomiting of bile.
Vertical and frontal headache. θ Paralysis.
Occasional rush of blood to head. θ Nervous debility.
Congestion of blood to head, with pulsative vibrative pains and loss of consciousness.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Cur.]
Head drawn backward, with stiffness of neck, swinging and trembling of hands. θ Headache.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cur.]
Eyes haggard, sunken. θ Nervous debility.
Black spots before vision (patient quite myopic), especially < from reading. θ Nervous debility.
Ptosis on right side.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Cur.]
Different noises in ears, as of whistling, or crying of animals.
Unbearable earache ; loses consciousness.
Lancinating nervous pains, starting from ears, and reaching down to legs, obliged to lie down.
Internal otitis, driving one crazy ; purulent discharge.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Cur.]
Ozæna, with fetid lumps of pus, of six years standing.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cur.]
Dull, anxious expression, with clay-colored skin. θ Ulcer of os uteri.
Redness of face, head beats like a hammer, after fever.
Aching of right side of face. θ Paralysis.
Facial and buccal paralysis ; in some cases with difficulty in swallowing.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Cur.]
Blueness of lips, body purple, with fever.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cur.]
Tongue deep red, cracked and bleeding.
Tongue and mouth drawn to right side. θ Paralysis.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Cur.]
Dry mouth. θ Diabetes.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Cur.]
Paralytic failure of power to swallow.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cur.]
Appetite variable. θ Paralysis.
Thirst and great hunger with the fever.
Great thirst, especially evenings and at night. θ Diabetes.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Cur.]
Amelioration after first mouthful of food.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cur.]
Hiccough frequent and annoying. θ Nervous debility.
Nausea in morning. θ Nervous debility. θ Paralysis.
Gastric troubles, nausea after eating, or in morning.
Dry, spasmodic cough provokes vomiting.
Vomits green bile all night, nasty taste ; bad feeling in stomach ; so weak, cannot stand or her feet.
